author: fchollet
text:
At some point in evolutionary history, matter learned to feel. We don't know how. It wouldn't be scientific to dismiss the possibility that it could happen again.

(I don't believe it happens in current AI systems, because they don't have the charactistics I would expect to see in a sentient agent)
